intro.objective: Multiply and divide numbers in standard form. Add and subtract numbers in standard form. Give answers in correct standard form.
commonMistakes: Forgetting to adjust A back into standard form — (4 × 10³) × (5 × 10²) = 20 × 10⁵ → must be rewritten as 2 × 10⁶.
Subtracting powers when you should add (multiply → add powers; divide → subtract powers).
For addition/subtraction: you MUST have the same power of 10 before combining.
Losing the 10ⁿ part when doing the calculation with just the A values.
methodSteps: Step 1: Multiplication — multiply A values, ADD powers of 10.
Step 2: Division — divide A values, SUBTRACT powers of 10.
Step 3: Check A is in range 1 ≤ A < 10. If not, adjust.
Step 4: Addition/subtraction — rewrite both numbers with the SAME power of 10, then combine A values.
Step 5: Give final answer in correct standard form.
workedExample: Calculate (3 × 10⁴) × (6 × 10⁵). Give your answer in standard form.

questions.content:
Multiply. Give answers in standard form.

   a) (2 × 10³) × (3 × 10²)
   b) (4 × 10⁵) × (2 × 10⁴)

Divide. Give answers in standard form.

   a) (8 × 10⁷) ÷ (2 × 10³)
   b) (9 × 10⁶) ÷ (3 × 10²)

Calculate. Give answers in standard form.

   a) (5 × 10⁴) × (7 × 10³)
   b) (6 × 10⁻²) × (4 × 10⁵)
   c) (1.2 × 10⁶) ÷ (4 × 10²)

Add. Give answers in standard form.

   a) (3 × 10⁴) + (5 × 10⁴)
   b) (2.4 × 10⁵) + (6 × 10⁴)
   c) (7 × 10³) + (3 × 10²)

Subtract. Give answers in standard form.

   a) (8 × 10⁵) − (3 × 10⁵)
   b) (5.2 × 10⁴) − (8 × 10³)
   c) (1.5 × 10⁻²) − (3 × 10⁻³)

The Sun is 1.5 × 10⁸ km from Earth. Light travels at 3 × 10⁵ km/s.

   a) How long does sunlight take to reach Earth? Give answer in standard form.  (2 marks)
   b) Convert your answer to minutes.  (2 marks)

A grain of sand has mass 6.5 × 10⁻⁵ kg. A bag contains 2 × 10⁶ grains.

   a) Total mass of sand in the bag? Standard form.  (2 marks)
   b) How many bags to make 1 tonne (1 × 10³ kg)? Standard form.  (3 marks)

answers.title: Teacher key
rows: Q8: a) 6.5 × 10⁻⁵ × 2 × 10⁶ = 13 × 10¹ = 1.3 × 10² = 130 kg  b) 1000 ÷ 130 = 7.69… → 8 bags (round up). In standard form: ≈ 7.7 × 10⁰ bags needed (accept 8).
